metadata.description: Tools for cycling race promoters and teams working with BikeReg event data.

plugins.name: bikereg-registrations
plugins.description: Ask for BikeReg event IDs (up to 20) and get one verified CSV of every registration: name, category, gender, team, city, state, reg date.

plugins.name: race-review-deck
plugins.description: Turn BikeReg registration CSVs and a race logo into a post-race review deck (.pptx): category, gender, location, team, registration-timing and retention trends, year over year, with outliers and takeaways.
